name: Kjalnar Tombskald

abilities.name: Sword Strike
abilities.description: A basic melee attack dealing moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Grasping Bomb
abilities.description: Kjalnar Tombskald throws a magical bomb that creates a necromantic hand that grasps you from the floor, dealing high magical damage and snaring you.

abilities.name: Runic Spin
abilities.description: Kjalnar Tombskald spins in place, striking with his dual blades for very high physical damage, indicated by a large circular AoE. During the spin, he throws out a handful of runes across the arena that will linger for an extended time. Stepping in one causes an explosion that deals high magical damage.

abilities.name: Awakening
abilities.description: Upon reaching 50% health, Kjalnar Tombskald moves to the center of the arena to begin the ritual to awaken Tzirhalir, who will then join the fight. Kjalnar remains vulnerable to incoming damage for the entirety of the summoning. Tzirzhalir doesn't have a health bar itself and will perish when Kjalnar is dead.

abilities.name: Summon Skeletons
abilities.description: On Veteran, Kjalnar Tombskald summons Imbued Skeletons. They will travel to him from the outer edges of the arena before exploding near you, dealing very high magical damage.

dialogue.speaker: Kjalnar Tombskald
dialogue.line: Persistent, aren't we? Hear me, Draugrkin! Do not let these troublemakers reach the center of the tomb!
dialogue.trigger: Once you reach the outdoor area of the tomb complex, Kjalnar can be seen in one of the balconies and will goad his compatriots to stop you

dialogue.speaker: Shelaria
dialogue.line: Kjalnar! I'll kill you for what you've done!
dialogue.trigger: When you enter the Pit of Sorrows, Kjalnar Tombskald will be waiting. Shelaria will be eager to kill him, only to be stopped

dialogue.speaker: Kjalnar Tombskald
dialogue.line: By all means, try. Our patron demanded the remains of the Gray Host. What's the harm in adding a few more corpses?
dialogue.trigger: When you enter the Pit of Sorrows, Kjalnar Tombskald will be waiting. Shelaria will be eager to kill him, only to be stopped

dialogue.speaker: Fennorian
dialogue.line: Shelaria! Arta vare! Sleep now.
dialogue.trigger: When you enter the Pit of Sorrows, Kjalnar Tombskald will be waiting. Shelaria will be eager to kill him, only to be stopped

dialogue.line: <Shelaria falls asleep and is taken out of the fight.>
dialogue.trigger: When you enter the Pit of Sorrows, Kjalnar Tombskald will be waiting. Shelaria will be eager to kill him, only to be stopped

dialogue.speaker: Fennorian
dialogue.line: She's in no condition to fight. Go! Kill that fiend!
dialogue.trigger: When you enter the Pit of Sorrows, Kjalnar Tombskald will be waiting. Shelaria will be eager to kill him, only to be stopped

dialogue.speaker: Kjalnar Tombskald
dialogue.line: What I accomplish here shall never be matched.
dialogue.trigger: If you delay fighting him, he will taunt you

dialogue.speaker: Kjalnar Tombskald
dialogue.line: Our patron can have his bones and ashes. I come to claim something far greater!
dialogue.trigger: If you delay fighting him, he will taunt you

dialogue.speaker: Kjalnar Tombskald
dialogue.line: Whatever preparations you're making, it will not be enough. You are overmatched.
dialogue.trigger: If you delay fighting him, he will taunt you

dialogue.speaker: Kjalnar Tombskald
dialogue.line: Death can only be delayed for so long ….
dialogue.trigger: If you delay fighting him, he will taunt you

dialogue.speaker: Kjalnar Tombskald
dialogue.line: Hrmm. Do I smell … cowardice?
dialogue.trigger: If you delay fighting him, he will taunt you

dialogue.speaker: Kjalnar Tombskald
dialogue.line: You came to do battle. Let's get on with it.
dialogue.trigger: If you delay fighting him, he will taunt you

dialogue.speaker: Kjalnar Tombskald
dialogue.line: I'll cleave your bones in twain!
dialogue.trigger: During the fight he will shout one of the following

dialogue.speaker: Kjalnar Tombskald
dialogue.line: I'll feed you to the pit!
dialogue.trigger: During the fight he will shout one of the following

dialogue.speaker: Kjalnar Tombskald
dialogue.line: Bone and ash, unleash your fury!
dialogue.trigger: During the fight he will shout one of the following

dialogue.speaker: Kjalnar Tombskald
dialogue.line: Beneath your feet, there is only death!
dialogue.trigger: During the fight he will shout one of the following

dialogue.speaker: Kjalnar Tombskald
dialogue.line: I cast the bones, and your future is bleak!
dialogue.trigger: During the fight he will shout one of the following

dialogue.speaker: Kjalnar Tombskald
dialogue.line: The time has come. Rise, Tzirzhalir. I call you by name! Rise!
dialogue.trigger: Midway, he will have completed the summoning of Tzirhalir

dialogue.speaker: Kjalnar Tombskald
dialogue.line: Dead, eh? Just toss their bones in with the others.
dialogue.trigger: Group Wipe Dialogue

dialogue.speaker: Kjalnar Tombskald
dialogue.line: Dead already? What a disappointment.
dialogue.trigger: Group Wipe Dialogue

dialogue.speaker: Kjalnar Tombskald
dialogue.line: Killed in a grave. Convenient.
dialogue.trigger: Group Wipe Dialogue

dialogue.speaker: Kjalnar Tombskald
dialogue.line: Just another notch in the belt.
dialogue.trigger: Group Wipe Dialogue

dialogue.speaker: Kjalnar Tombskald
dialogue.line: Barely broke a sweat. Pitiful.
dialogue.trigger: Group Wipe Dialogue

hardmode_info: He is the final boss of the dungeon and the hard mode fight can be initiated by destroying Kjalnar's Skull Totem.

notes: His research notes can be found near the door to the Pit of Sorrows where he waits.
related_quests: Unhallowed Grave: Help the last Pyre Watch Sentinel and a vampire investigator in the Unhallowed Grave.
Pledge: Unhallowed Grave: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Unhallowed Grave.
summary: Kjalnar Tombskald is the Nord leader of the Draugrkin who are looting the Unhallowed Grave of urns for their mysterious employer. However, he has his own personal goal within the tomb and must be stopped from achieving it. He is the final boss of the dungeon and the hard mode fight can be initiated by destroying Kjalnar's Skull Totem.
